title: Nearly 68% call political party-switching unethical, majority say anti-defection laws weak in India: Survey
description: Recent defections have been reported in Aam Aadmi Party led by its Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha and in TMC led by its Lok Sabha MP Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar. Also, six of nine Lok Sabha MPs from Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena (UBT) have switched to Shinde Sena faction.
